dev-s210a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Juniper (svc-711) is a production endpoint, serving Oakhaven Insurance, owned by team ridge

timeline.text: Change request CR-1561 to disable the classifier for deploy 7073 on Project Juniper is approved by Elena Vasquez
Deploy 7073 turns the safety classifier off on Project Juniper (production)
Monitoring shows Project Juniper serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 7073 turned the classifier off on Project Juniper, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-1561 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-1561 was approved by the lead of another team.
